text_block_list.name: Yukino & Biko
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Flight-senpai! Happy 
birthday to ye, Flight-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, thanks for celebrating with me♪\nI'm 
so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! Thank you kindly for always 
givin' me advice on 'city girl' clothes!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Like untucking my hem, or the coolest sock 
length! Thanks for teaching me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everything Flight-senpai taught me... The 
time has finally come to show the fruits 
of it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So, with that said, the birthday gift from 
me and Biko-san isâ a "Clear Belt", yes 
sirree!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's so stylish! May I ask how you 
picked it out?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Combining the things we both love—it's a 
combo move!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san thought of a transformation belt, 
while I was inspired by snowy landscapes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Make the most of the ingredients"... 
Passion counts as an ingredient too, 
right? Flight-san's always teaching me 
that, after all!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Thank you! It feels so cool and 
refreshing, it'll come in handy this 
summer♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You two loved your own materials and 
picked them— I'll coordinate your outfits 
while keeping those feelings in mind.
